about.problemText: Managing properties by hand — notebooks, scattered receipts, late payments discovered too late — wastes time and money. And when you live far from your buildings, everything gets more complicated. CizaImmo brings order to management: every building, every unit, every lease and every payment in one place, with alerts before problems arise.
about.title: About CizaImmo
about.whoText: CizaImmo is Ciza Group's property management platform. We help owners and managers track their buildings, their tenants and their rents from one single place — at the office, at home or from abroad. The platform works in French and in English, in several currencies, on phone and on computer alike.

packEmploye.charteIntro: Welcome to the CizaImmo administration console. Your role gives you access to client files: their ID documents, proofs of ownership, agreements and messages. This information is strictly confidential.
packEmploye.charteBefore: Before continuing, please take the following undertakings:
packEmploye.charteItem1: I undertake to keep strictly confidential all client information I access: identity, documents, contact details, buildings, tenants and messages.
packEmploye.charteItem2: I undertake to use this information only for the tasks entrusted to me in the platform — never for personal purposes, nor on behalf of a third party.
packEmploye.charteItem3: I undertake never to disclose, copy, photograph or take out of the platform any client information or document, except where strictly required for the service and with the Super Admin's agreement.
packEmploye.charteItem4: I undertake never to share my account or my password: my access is personal, and I am responsible for everything done from my account.
packEmploye.charteItem5: I undertake to check every file rigorously, following the provided checklist, and never to approve an incomplete or suspicious file — a document is never taken as genuine without verification.
packEmploye.charteItem6: I undertake to immediately report to the Super Admin any anomaly, suspicious document, attempted fraud or security incident.
packEmploye.charteItem7: I undertake to reply to clients courteously and accurately, without ever making a financial commitment on behalf of CizaImmo.
packEmploye.charteItem8: I undertake to return, at the end of my mission, all of the company's access, documents and media, and to keep no copy of client information.
packEmploye.charteUnderstand: I understand that each of my actions in the console is logged (who did what, and when) and may be consulted by the Super Admin, and that any breach of this charter may lead to immediate suspension of my access as well as the sanctions provided for by my employment contract and by law.
packEmploye.charteCheckbox: I have read and I accept the confidentiality charter.
packEmploye.charteNote: By clicking “I accept”, your acceptance is recorded with the date and time, and kept in your employee file.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what data CizaImmo collects, why, and what your rights are. It applies to cizaimmo.com and to the CizaImmo app.
privacy.s1Text: Your account: name, email, country, main currency and language. Your portfolio: buildings, apartments, tenants, leases, declared rents, expenses and documents you upload. Your messages: the content of contact and demo-request forms.
privacy.s2Text: To run the service: show your portfolio, compute your indicators (occupancy, collection, arrears, ROI), generate your receipts and your alerts. To reply when you contact us. Nothing else.
privacy.s3Text: Your data is never sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes. It is hosted by our technical providers (app hosting and database), who can only access it to run the service. Subscription payments are processed by Stripe (card) or by your mobile-money operator: CizaImmo never sees or stores your card numbers.
privacy.s4Text: Your data is kept while your account is active. After your subscription ends, it stays available read-only for 90 days, then is deleted. You can request deletion of your account at any time by email.
privacy.s5Text: You can view, correct and export your data from the app, and request its deletion by writing to infos@cizagroup.com. You can also revoke a manager's or a co-owner's access at any time: access is revoked immediately.
privacy.s6Text: Access to your portfolio is protected by your password (two-factor authentication offered in settings) and by database-level rules: one account can never read or change another account's data, even by editing a page address.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

terms.intro: By creating a CizaImmo account, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.s1Text: CizaImmo is an online property-management software: buildings and blocks, apartments, tenants, declared rents, expenses, documents and profitability. The service is provided in French and English, on the web and on phones.
terms.s2Text: Sign-up opens a free 30-day trial with the Pro plan's features, no bank card required; the trial starts when you confirm your email. When the trial ends, access becomes read-only until a subscription is active: you can still view and export your data, but no longer enter anything. The subscription is paid by bank card (Stripe) or by mobile money (EcoCash, Lumicash, eNoti); it is activated only after the payment is confirmed. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the period.
terms.s3Text: CizaImmo never collects rent and never holds money on behalf of third parties. The product is funded 100% by subscription. It only records payments declared by the owner or the manager. CizaImmo does not distribute money between co-owners either: co-ownership only shows the calculated income split.
terms.s4Text: You are responsible for the accuracy of the data you enter (rents, leases, declared payments) and for keeping your password confidential. You must not enter illegal data, nor try to access another account's portfolio.
terms.s5Text: The exchange rates shown are dated reference rates from an external service; they are not a live rate and are never presented as one. The “apartments for rent” showcase is a listings service: CizaImmo takes no booking and no online payment; contact is made directly with the owner or the manager.
terms.s6Text: You can cancel at any time: access stays active until the end of the paid period, then becomes read-only for 90 days before data is deleted. CizaImmo may suspend an account in case of a serious breach of these terms, after informing you.
terms.title: Terms of use
